request.effort: provider default (high); output_config is not sent
request.sampling_parameters: none sent; temperature, top_p and top_k are rejected with a 400 by the models this experiment runs
request.transport: urllib (stdlib); no SDK, by project choice

retry.note: a non-retryable status (400/401/403/404) fails immediately; a truncated or textless reply is not retried either -- it is returned as an error so the row degrades rather than spending the budget again on the same cap

credential.note: presence only; the value is never recorded anywhere

scoring.instead_of: a hash of scoring.py, which T6 changed by adding the necessity metrics
sections_not_reproduced: planner (parsed from run_*.log, not from any score)
vii_decision_rule (joins claim and tool-call ids across arms; grader logic)
i..vi, labels, degraded, identity_hygiene (row fields the grader re-counts; the scores they count are covered by the per-row round trip)

divergence.reason: the T2 mitigation. Without it arm B degrades on any case whose tool results are large; flaws_cloud/CASE-256 carries 108 deterministic facts from 17 tool calls. The bound changes only how already-verified claim evidence is rendered for synthesis. Arm A never synthesises and is unaffected; B and C receive the same bound.
